page.title: Njikọ
page.intro: Jikọọ akaụntụ mgbasa ozi gị. Ndị ndu sitere na mgbasa ozi gị na-abata na Nduzi m na-akpaghị aka, yana mmefu na ọnụ ahịa otu ụzọ.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form na-eduga n'ime Nduzi M, mmefu kwa ụbọchị na ọnụ ahịa otu ụzọ, yana àgwà ndu ezigara azụ na LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: Njikọ LinkedIn . A na-ebute ụzọ ugbu a - na-emelite ibe a n'otu ntabi anya.
banner.notConfigured: Edobebeghị LinkedIn na sava a. Onye nchịkwa ga-etinyerịrị ID onye ahịa na nzuzo nke ngwa LinkedIn .
banner.expired: Njikọ LinkedIn kubiela, yabụ ndị ndu anaghị emekọrịta. Jikọọ ọzọ ka ịga n'ihu.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn chọrọ ka ị banye ọzọ site na {{date}} . Jikọọ ọzọ tupu mgbe ahụ ka ọ nọgide na-eduzi.

connect.title: Jikọọ LinkedIn
connect.intro: Jiri akaụntụ LinkedIn banye na-ejikwa mgbasa ozi gị. Leadrat na-agụ naanị akaụntụ mgbasa ozi gị, Lead Gen Form na-eduga na ọnụ ọgụgụ mgbasa ozi, ma na-eziga ntụgharị ị gbanye.
connect.need1: Ọrụ na akaụntụ mgbasa ozi LinkedIn (Onye nlele ma ọ bụ karịa).
connect.need2: Ọrụ dị na ibe ụlọ ọrụ ejikọtara (Onye nchịkwa, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator or Analyst) - LinkedIn chọrọ ka ọ kesaa ụzọ.
connect.need3: Ajụjụ nọmba ekwentị na Lead Gen Forms gị - enweghị ike ịgbakwunye nọmba ekwentị.

connection.fetchTitle: Weta ụzọ site na oke ụbọchị
connection.fetchHint: A na-enyocha ụzọ ọhụrụ ọ bụla nkeji ole na ole ma a na-enyochaghachi ụbọchị 7 ikpeazụ kwa ụbọchị, n'ihi ya ọ dịghị ihe na-efunahụ ya. Jiri nke a maka ụzọ tupu ị jikọọ, ma ọ bụ ịlele oge ọzọ (ruo ụbọchị 90 n'otu oge). Awụpụla ndu ndị dị na Leadrat .

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Gwa LinkedIn nke n'ime ụzọ ya ghọrọ ezigbo atụmanya. Mgbe onye ndu LinkedIn ruru ọkwa ị họọrọ n'okpuru ebe a, Leadrat na-akọ ya na LinkedIn , ya mere akụkọ mgbasa ozi gị na-egosi àgwà ndu na LinkedIn nwere ike ịhụ ndị ọzọ dị ka ụzọ kacha mma gị. Naanị LinkedIn ndu ID na hash nke email ka a na-eziga.
capi.type: Kpọọ akụkọ na LinkedIn dị ka
capi.created: Ntugharị emepụtara na LinkedIn wee mee maapụ.

activity.title: Ndekọ mmemme
activity.intro: Ihe niile dị n'etiti Leadrat na LinkedIn : njikọ, mmekọrịta ọ bụla, ụzọ ọ bụla na ihe mere ya, ntụgharị na njehie.
